title: Roxy the raccoon: a real raccoon look
kaylee: Roxy and her kits now look like raccoons: a bandit mask, white brows and cheek fluff, round ears and a big ringed tail.

pictures.title: Front
pictures.caption: Bandit mask with white brows, eye-whites and brown eyes, a pointed white snout, cheek fluff, round white-rimmed ears, a pale tummy

pictures.title: Three-quarters
pictures.caption: The tail is one bushy tube with dark rings, curling round her side so it shows from the front
